_note: [ODIN C3] the 98-99 CANDIDATE, designed from the measured record rather than guessed. THREE things the wide fabric changes and one it does not. (1) GEOMETRY: 1023 effective slots means the 784-line raster plus its always-on bias row maps WHOLE onto one core, which the 127-slot stock crossbar refuses outright -- the simple_mlp family is what that unlocks. (2) THE WEIGHT GRID: the stock cell is a 4-bit unsigned magnitude signed per row, [-7, 7], and WeightQuantizationStep refused this family there by name (BiasGridDominanceError: max|effective bias| / max|effective weight| = 5.7 against the q_max/2 = 3.5 limit at 4 bits). At wb=8 that limit is 63.5 and the same ratio clears it with room. (3) THETA: a 16-bit membrane raises the threshold ceiling from 255 to 65,535, and theta is the divisor in the emission bound -- which is the headroom the count currency needs. WHAT IT DID NOT CHANGE, until C4, is that currency itself: at C3 this cell deployed 0.9800 and was REFUSED at export by a 127-event ceiling its readout core exceeded at 146. C4 made the currency a CHIP-CLAIMED quantity -- the largest signed word of the width the chip declares its registers at -- so this 16-bit fabric carries 32,767 and the stock fabric still carries 127. The same cached run re-exports at the same 0.9800 as odin_wide_mlp_mnist_wb8_s16: 3 host-mediated passes in causal order [1, 2, 0], 300 samples, 50 certified, frozen accuracy 0.990000, 4,427,414 bytes, peak emission bound 146 against 32,767. It is the deployment package's DEFAULT bundle. S=16 AND NOT 4: measured on the deployment cell, S is the largest lever there is (0.8790 / 0.9129 / 0.9366 at S = 4 / 8 / 16 for a two-key edit), and the A6 temporal gauge reads this network's chain first-fire delay at 6.44 cycles -- a delay/window ratio of 1.61 at S=4 (the deepest hop fires after the window has closed) against 0.40 at S=16.
